text_block_list.text:
The day of the Asahi Hai FS. Yaeno Muteki 
went to watch Sakura Chiyono O, thinking 
she might become a worthy rival.

She believed that finding worthy rivals, 
polishing herself, and growing was the 
true way to repay her grandfather, who had 
saved her when she had nearly lost her 
way.

Meanwhile, Mejiro Ardan received a 
doctor's stop and couldn't even come to 
watch... Her body truly seemed 
exceptionally fragile.

Reflecting deeply on running in the Asahi 
Hai FS, a race Maruzensky had won in the 
past, Sakura Chiyono O headed toward the 
paddock.
